title: Registry Add
statement: Implement `solve(registrations, kind)`. `registrations` is a list of `[kind, builder]` pairs in order. A duplicate kind returns `error` for the whole registration and does not silently overwrite. If registration succeeds, return the builder name for `kind`, or `missing` if that kind was never registered.
hints: Insert into a dict only when the kind is new.
On a duplicate, return error immediately.
After a clean insert pass, look up kind.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A factory registry that overwrites a kind hides two teams registering the same name.

editorial: A factory registry that overwrites a kind hides two teams registering the same name. Rejecting the duplicate makes the clash visible at startup. The lookup after a clean registration is the normal factory path.
